note: The standard is ASCII text. 'allow' preserves reviewed typography that
carries structural meaning in ASCII diagrams and status legends; it may
NARROW the standard but never disable it.
'deny' always beats 'allow' - a codepoint listed in both refuses to run.
U+00A7 SECTION SIGN is DENIED: it renders as a dollar-ish glyph in some
clients and is not an English-language character (the reported defect).
'strict_zero' paths are ZERO TOLERANCE: the ratchet baseline may not
grandfather them. Every row carries a reason. Add a row only after review.

deny.reason: SECTION SIGN - the reported defect: renders as a dollar-ish glyph and is not English. Use 'Sec.'.
VARIATION SELECTOR-16 - invisible emoji modifier; strips to nothing meaningful.
ZERO WIDTH SPACE - invisible; never intentional in tracked text.
ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE / BOM - encoding artifact.
bidi embedding/override controls - invisible, can reorder displayed text.
emoji and pictographs - decorative, not English text. Priority labels are words.

strict_zero.reason: the published spec corpus is what consumers read and what this defect was reported against twice; it gets no ratchet exemption.
workflow files are executed by CI; a glyph that changes a regex or a shell word is a behaviour change.

allow.reason: BOX DRAWING - ASCII-art tables and architecture diagrams across the spec corpus.
BLOCK ELEMENTS - progress bars in runner/monitor output.
EN DASH - numeric ranges in tables.
EM DASH - prose punctuation in existing docs.
HORIZONTAL ELLIPSIS - truncated excerpts in logs/quotes.
RIGHT SINGLE QUOTATION MARK - prose apostrophe.
BULLET - list marker in imported docs.
MIDDLE DOT - separator in status legends.
HEAVY CHECK MARK - status legend glyph.
WHITE HEAVY CHECK MARK - status legend glyph.
MINUS SIGN - math notation in formulas.
RIGHTWARDS DOUBLE ARROW - implies (=>) in logic.
LEFT RIGHT DOUBLE ARROW - iff (<->) in logic.
GREEK SMALL MU - micro- prefix in units.
